entries.chemistry: Hydrolysis/condensation of suitably functional silane precursors can form Si–O–Si skeletons. Mainly difunctional chain-forming units with controlled ends permit oils; multifunctional units yield resin networks; suitably crosslinked flexible siloxane chains produce rubbers. Cure can also use addition routes: not every silicone is made by one universal process.
entries.manufacturePropertyUseExamples: Use given representative precursor functionality and route. Flowing uncrosslinked oil can suit lubrication; more rigid resin networks can suit coating/binder duties; lightly crosslinked flexible chains can suit seals. Chemical substitution, crosslink density, service conditions and grade-specific data limit each claim.
entries.avoid: Do not claim silicone oil is never oligomeric, every resin is fully brittle, every rubber is PDMS or every silicone must universally withstand all temperatures. Full oil/resin/rubber coverage cannot be replaced by only PDMS oil versus one elastomer. Nano and cosmetics are not new HB34 literal demands.

entries.chemistry: At a suitable schematic level, alcohol O attacks electrophilic C in R–N=C=O, with redistribution of pi electrons and proton transfer to N leading to R–NH–C(=O)–O–Rprime. A charge-balanced zwitterionic addition representation followed by a justified proton-transfer route is acceptable; catalysts/solvent and transfer partners may change microscopic steps.
entries.avoid: The product equation alone is not a mechanism. Do not invent water elimination from the dry urethane step, identify polyaddition with radical chain growth, or present a free uncatalysed intramolecular proton jump as the unique universal microscopic route. Do not infer completed kinetics from a correct arrow scheme.

entries.chemistry: A suitable supplied fixing example is AgBr(s)+2 S2O3^2−(aq) -> [Ag(S2O3)2]^3−(aq)+Br−(aq). Complexation binds dissolved Ag(I) and favours further AgBr dissolution. This is not reduction of all silver species and does not itself form the metallic image; fixing removes undeveloped light-sensitive halide under appropriate bath conditions.
entries.avoid: No EDTA water-hardness titration, silver nanoparticle packaging, claim of destroying the whole Ag(0) image, prescribed learner experiment, or universal insolubility/oxidation claim. Neighbouring experimental fixing work remains a separate actual practical duty.

entries.chemistry: Compare given chosen systems: suitable radical initiation by heat/light with an initiator and conditions limiting inhibition; step-growth condensation with suitable catalysis/temperature and handling of a small-molecule product where relevant; chosen isocyanate–OH polyaddition with control of moisture, reaction heat and functional-group proportions. Condensation implementations and other polyaddition families differ: conditions are not universal class labels.
entries.avoid: Do not claim all polymerizations require heat, all polycondensations require the same temperature, all polyadditions are moisture-sensitive, all catalysts shift thermodynamic equilibrium, or initiation and catalysis are the same operation. Executing a kinetics experiment does not establish three-route comparison.
